BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; appropriating money for the Minnesota Agricultural Interpretive Center - Farmamerica.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS.

$215,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $215,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for grants to the Minnesota Agricultural Interpretive Center - Farmamerica.
additions: $215,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $215,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Minnesota Historical Society for grants to the Minnesota Agricultural Interpretive Center - Farmamerica.
